outcome: Pagination is added to the audit-log listing.

acceptance_criteria.text: Requesting page N returns exactly page_size rows starting at offset (N-1)*page_size.

expected_verification.assertion: page(2) returns rows 26 through 50, in order

acceptance_criteria.text: The /audit?page=N endpoint calls the paginator and returns its rows as JSON.

expected_verification.assertion: a request for page=1 returns a 200 with 25 rows as JSON
